node.title: Raw-two quadratic moving normals pay throughout the original rank-twelve gap
node.statement: For EVERY original KoalaBear MCA rank12 source J9965..21499 and assignment, any declared degree-two moving-normal Q with independent functionals and fixed offsets gives |Z_bad|<=floor[(756693789832986395+2*x)/3]+134944, where x counts original raw<=2 labels outside Q. Graph containment pays252231263277797075; formal P2 pair-line containment pays252214244730017023. Every over-budget assignment has>=34124197250397019 low labels outside EACH such Q. Uses the uniform T7 basis lemma on actual raw<=2 cores, not a G7 containment premise; original HIGH, moving-zero and noncontained-line labels and near remain once. No arbitrary quadratic cover, whole J, active atom or Prize closure.
